contentText: More than 550,000 candidates sat South Korea’s Suneung university entrance exam under extraordinary security, after an AI cheating scandal in which a top scorer on a national tax accountant exam admitted using a hidden mini camera to send questions to an AI system. Authorities inspected students’ glasses, deployed thousands of extra supervisors and ordered stickers over every button on candidates’ clothing. A nationwide disaster alert was also sent to make even muted phones buzz, exposing any devices smuggled into exam rooms.
